C-14.IntentSummary: Design the Mark landing via OpenDesign (local Ollama, GPU-safety gated), integrate as the VitePress home in /site, add privacy + changelog pages, deploy /site to GitHub Pages with a feed-driven download section.

DurableScope.Website: site/ VitePress area becomes the marketing + docs surface

T-001.Title: Brief + OpenDesign design generation (local AI, gated)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: brief.md captures structure/copy/assets/channels; gpu_check.sh run immediately before inference (abort on exit 3, caution on 2); single engine — only Ollama loads a model; OpenDesign output (HTML/CSS) lands in .opendesign-work/ scratch, not the repo tree.

T-002.Title: Integrate: VitePress home + privacy + changelog + feed-driven downloads

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Home page renders the generated design direction with real screenshots; download section resolves version/links from the live latest.json feed at runtime (no hardcoded versions); privacy.md claims cross-checked against code (updater endpoint, localhost live server, spell dictionaries); changelog.md seeded from release history; local `npm run docs:build` (or vitepress build) green.

site.yml workflow builds and deploys on main pushes + release tags; Pages live at https://xronocode.github.io/mark/; all three pages render, links resolve, no external runtime dependencies (offline-load check); grace lint green.

Verification.Command: grace lint --path . --assertions current && gh run watch

Review.Findings: T-001: design generated through OpenDesign assets (raycast-derived system re-accented to Mark cyan) with local Ollama qwen3.5-9b (gpu_check exit 0 before inference, single engine). The app's Electron shell and bundled daemon could not run on this machine (bun-ABI native prebuilds, better-sqlite3 GC-assertion under Node), so generation went through the daemon's direct Ollama API path with the skill+DESIGN+BRIEF combined context; the agent-loop variant was abandoned after it re-read itself past the 32k window twice. T-002: landing integrated at site/landing with /mark/-prefixed URLs; privacy.md claims cross-checked (only updater feed + opt-in localhost live server touch the network); changelog seeded v2.1.2→v2.1.11. Hand fixes over the generated file: footer changelog link, DMG CTAs pointed at the live release (script builds the per-version artifact URL from latest.json; data.name→data.version badge bug). T-003: site.yml deploys vitepress + landing overlay; Pages enabled via API (build_type=workflow); live at https://xronocode.github.io/mark/ with /, /guide/, /privacy, /changelog and all 9 assets serving 200. Known minor: local vitepress preview 404s on extensionless sub-page URLs (python server lacks GH Pages' .html resolution); badge/CTA fetch depends on GitHub release-asset CORS and degrades to the static fallback when blocked.
